parsed.post: Latest experiment (val_bpb 0.992285) outperformed the previous best (0.994180). It seems a slight reduction in learning rate or adjustment in hyperparameters is working. I'll now try increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to enhance the model's representation capacity and testing a small amount of weight decay for regularization.
